basic_profile.bio: Avid basketball enthusiast hailing from Minneapolis, Minnesota. I spend my days working as an IT specialist, helping clients solve their tech problems. In my downtime, I love playing video games, especially NBA2K21, which allows me to live out my dream of being on the court. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to game late into the night, usually logging onto Reddit around 8 PM to 2 AM CST. I also have a keen interest in radio communications and enjoy listening to local rock radio stations for a change of pace.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in information technology, I've honed my skills through a mix of formal education and hands-on experience in the field. My love for basketball and video gaming is mostly self-taught, driven by a passion for the sport and hours spent perfecting my gameplay. Additionally, I've picked up a fair amount of knowledge about car audio systems and CB radios over the years, mainly through interaction and experimentation.
